evidence.proved: the CDXJ index is heavily rate limited and blocks an IP address that sends too many requests, so request-rate is the constraint that binds reads
evidence.quote: Our CDX API endpoint is frequently abused and therefore heavily rate limited. If your client sends too many requests in a short period of time, your IP address may be temporarily blocked.

evidence.proved: index lookups and single-capture reads stay rate bound under load, so request-rate binds reads
evidence.quote: This retry technique does not work well enough for partial file downloads, such as index lookups and downloading individual webpage captures from within a WARC file.
